$schema_note: Static behaviour record. No code is executed by this file.
rule: Project.resolve(workspace_slug, value): try uuid.UUID(str(value)) -> filter(pk=value, workspace__slug, deleted_at NULL); on ValueError/AttributeError/TypeError -> filter(workspace__slug, identifier=str(value).strip().upper(), deleted_at NULL). No row -> Http404('Project not found') with a GENERIC message (never echoes the input). UUID-looking input is NEVER tried as an identifier and non-UUID input is NEVER tried as a pk.
rewrite_middleware: BaseAPIView.initial() calls _rewrite_project_kwarg BEFORE DRF check_permissions (views/base.py:52-104,112-115): the project_id kwarg (member/state/estimate routes) or the pk kwarg when url_name == 'project' (detail route only) is replaced in-place with the canonical UUID string, so permission classes (which filter project_id=<uuid>) see a UUID. UUID input is accepted as-is WITHOUT an existence check (a bogus UUID proceeds to the view and 404/403s there). Skipped entirely for unauthenticated callers (no slug-existence oracle: anonymous gets 401 before any lookup).
scope: Applies to project_id kwargs and the project-detail pk only. Member-detail pk (<uuid:pk>), state_id, estimate_id, estimate_point_id are UUID converters and accept UUIDs only. workspace slug is never rewritten.

why_not_iexact: identifier match uses exact equality on the upper-cased input to use the composite btree project_unique_identifier_workspace_when_deleted_at_null (models/project.py:200-212 comment); save() always stores identifier upper-cased (models/project.py:258)
